references.summary: Warm-season annual oilseed. Cold soil can limit germination and seedling establishment; germination tolerance differs among genotypes. Water stress and excessive heat during flowering and seed filling can reduce productivity. A cereal-following catch crop is an observed system, not proof of universal predecessor preference. Emergence needs a suitable seedbed; shattering and uneven maturity influence harvest timing and losses.
